STANDALONE WEB APP

Install INSTASAVE HUB

ONE-CLICK INSTALLATION Direct installation available for your browser
INSTASAVE HUB is installed and active in standalone app mode on this device.
1
Open INSTASAVE HUB in Safari on your iPhone or iPad, then tap the Share button in the bottom toolbar.
2
Scroll down the share sheet and tap Add to Home Screen .
3
Tap Add in the top-right corner. The INSTASAVE HUB icon will appear on your Home Screen and run as a standalone app with full screen view.
1
Tap the Install App Now button above to launch the direct Android installation prompt.
2
If the prompt did not appear automatically, tap the three dots menu (⋮) in Chrome, Samsung Internet, or Edge.
3
Tap Install app or Add to Home screen to finish installation.
1
Click the Install App Now button above or click the Install icon located on the right side of your browser's address bar.
2
Alternatively, click the browser menu (⋮) → Save and Share → Install INSTASAVE HUB.
3
Click Install to add INSTASAVE HUB to your desktop and taskbar.
1
In the macOS menu bar at the top of your screen, click File.
2
Select Add to Dock... from the dropdown menu.
3
Click Add to launch INSTASAVE HUB directly from your Mac Dock as an independent native window.
Opened from Instagram or Facebook? Tap ⋯ and choose Open in Safari or Open in Chrome to install.
